items.claim: Raphael Tobias is a good grappler with solid takedowns and fantastic control on the ground.
items.quote: Raphael Tobias is a good grappler. He's got solid takedowns. He's big, he's strong, he's fast, he's athletic. He really shines on the ground. He's got fantastic control as well.

items.claim: Raphael Tobias's striking is not very good and he looks a little stiff.
items.quote: His striking is not very good. It It's not good at all. He's a little stiff, but he does stay protected

items.claim: Raphael Tobias has a limited ceiling and is not likely to put together a huge win streak.
items.quote: The ceiling's limited. He's certainly not a guy that'll put together a huge win streak and make something happen.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando is a long lead striker who is defensively sound with good clean head movement.
items.quote: He has taken on Lucas Fernando, a long lead striker. He moves forward. He keeps you at the end of his strikes. He's defensively sound. He's got good clean head movement.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando lacks true light heavyweight power but makes up for it with high volume.
items.quote: He doesn't really possess the light heavyweight power that you would want him to, but he's got good volume and he can find finishes because of that.
